items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: I was working at the Dancing School then, with Willy Martineau, the parody, up at 116th Street.

ctx.x: But the Bamboo Inn, yeah. But he had a band, and he had what you call a big band. He had three saxophones, three brass -- four brass, or three or four brass,

and a rhythm section, you know, so -- so I went up there one night. I was always scouting around with my nose in everything. I was working at the Dancing School then, with Willy Martineau, the parody, up at 116th Street. So during my travels I went around there -- I know why I went up there that night. My sister was going to business school up there on 134th Street somewhere, and I walked up there one night. So I said, "Let me go in this Bamboo Inn and see what's going on in there." It was a nice place in those…
And that was again playing arrangements?
